issue_request: FHIR-13162 was Published/Persuasive and asked for terminology value set/code system rendering to make nested hierarchy clearer, using the observation-status example where corrected refines amended. Jira comments classify the request as a tooling/publishing issue and record svn revision 12688 as the application.
initial_application: The historical git-svn commit 6a4cedca7fbf0317df18e4862f230bad94a59e2d (svn r12688), titled '13162 - fix rendering of nested expansions', added a Lvl column when value set expansions contain nested concepts and updated the value set template explanation. The old Java NarrativeGenerator path from that commit has since been removed or refactored, but current templates still retain the Lvl explanation.
additional_context: Current Observation and DiagnosticReport status CodeSystem sources declare hierarchyMeaning='is-a' and nest corrected under amended. source/fhir.ini has active ValueSet, CodeSystem, Observation, and DiagnosticReport resources. Current build.fhir.org pages render the cited status value sets/code systems with Lvl rows 1/2 for amended/corrected and describe the Observation status CodeSystem as an Is-A hierarchy. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published empty audit commit records that the requested hierarchy indication is already present in the current source-controlled templates, authoritative terminology source, and rendered CI output.
